summary: Preserve exact known RFI Status fields in evidence and the reviewer workflow without inferring a Question or Response role.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
Autodesk official RFI reports include Status, Question and Official Response fields and document explicit workflow statuses
Procore official RFI documentation exposes Draft, Open, Closed and Closed-Draft statuses
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only an explicit allowlist of documented common statuses is structured; project-specific values remain source text.
Status never proves that the Question or Official Response is present and never establishes contractual authority.
Conflicting statuses remain ambiguous because no timestamp or latest-version precedence is inferred.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer document, mailbox or provider tenant is used.
